resources.string: Could not sign in: the address or the password is not right. With two-step verification use a password for apps.
The message is too big for the server. Remove some files.
The server refused an address. Check the recipients.
No connection to the server. Check the network.
The certificate of the server is not valid: the connection was refused for your safety.
This folder has no trash: the message was not deleted.
Port 993 is TLS from the start; port 143 starts in the clear and switches to TLS before the password goes. A server that cannot do TLS is refused.
There is no trash in this folder: the messages (%1$d) would be deleted for good, with no way back. Delete them?
No connection: the message is kept and will be sent when there is one.
Lines added to the end of new messages
A square with the first letter of the sender and a dot on the messages not read yet.
One line of subject and no preview: more messages on the screen.
Messages and list in a bigger type.
On the dark theme the pages of messages are turned dark too (pictures stay as they are).
The list, the message and the page to write slide into each other.
Menu items to put a message in the archive, in the junk folder or in a folder you choose.
On a wide screen (a tablet, an unfolded phone) the list and the message are side by side.
While you type a recipient the addresses of your contacts are proposed. Needs the Contacts permission of the launcher.
Mark as read and delete (to the trash) from the notification of a new message, also with the screen locked.
Find the servers on the net
For an address of an unknown domain the settings are asked of the provider (autoconfig) or of the public database of Thunderbird: only the domain goes out, over HTTPS.
